bio.text: Erin Houchin represents Indiana's 9th District in the U.S. House and serves on the Rules, Budget, and Energy and Commerce committees.
She previously represented the 47th District in the Indiana Senate for eight years and owned a communications firm.

She has a bachelor's degree from Indiana University and a master's degree in political management from George Washington University; she was born in Southern Indiana and lives in Washington County, Indiana.
